transcript.speaker: Technical Lead
transcript.text: Okay, let's walk through the Checkout Service redesign. Backend Lead, take us through the new architecture. New Engineer, this will be a good deep dive for you.

transcript.speaker: Backend Lead
transcript.text: So the main change is decoupling the payment processing from the cart logic. We're introducing a new Payment Gateway service that handles all the Stripe integration.

transcript.speaker: New Engineer
transcript.text: How are you handling transaction consistency across the services?

transcript.speaker: Backend Lead
transcript.text: Good question. We're using a saga pattern with compensating transactions. If payment fails, we roll back the cart state.

transcript.speaker: Platform Lead
transcript.text: How does this affect deployment? Can we deploy them independently?

transcript.speaker: Backend Lead
transcript.text: Yes, that's the goal. The Payment Gateway will be a separate service. We'll use async messaging for the handoff.

transcript.speaker: Technical Lead
transcript.text: What about the Auth Service? I know there's been an issue with the Auth Token Refresh Bug.

transcript.speaker: Backend Lead
transcript.text: Good point. The Auth Token Refresh Bug is still open. When tokens expire during checkout, users get logged out. It's been causing cart abandonment.

transcript.speaker: New Engineer
transcript.text: I've dealt with this before. Are you using sliding window refresh or absolute expiration?

transcript.speaker: Backend Lead
transcript.text: Sliding window, but the issue is coordinating refreshes across microservices. Each service has its own auth middleware.

transcript.speaker: Platform Lead
transcript.text: That's a priority fix. New Engineer, if you want to pair on this, I think your experience would be really valuable.

transcript.speaker: New Engineer
transcript.text: Happy to. Let's sync after this.

transcript.speaker: Technical Lead
transcript.text: Perfect. Backend Lead, can you document the auth flow in the ADR and loop the New Engineer in?

transcript.speaker: Backend Lead
transcript.text: Will do. I'll have the Architecture Decision Record updated by Thursday.

transcript.speaker: Technical Lead
transcript.text: Great. This all feeds into the Platform Migration. Let's make sure we're aligned on timelines.
